subject: English
question_text: Write a paragraph on 'The Victory Day of Bangladesh'
stimulus: by answering the following questions. 10 (a) When is our Victory Day? (b) Why is it called the Victory Day? (c) How do we observe the day? (d) What is the importance of the day? (e) How do you feel on this day?
guide_solution: Paragraph writing The Victory Day of Bangldesh The 16th December is the Victory Day of Bangladesh. 16th December in 1971 Bangladesh has become independent from Pakistan. We celebrate this day every year with great respect and love. People of all walks of life celebrate the day to show their profound respect to the martyres. Govt. and non-govt. organizations arrange many functions and Radio, TV broadcast special functions on this day. The day is holiday and the National Flag is hoisted on the buildings of officials, shopping centres and residence houses. I go to the National Memorial at Savar to show respect to our martyred freedom fighters. On that day, we remember those heroic souls of the soil at the cost of whose blood victory has been achieved. It is the day of great pride and jubilation. On this day I feel great sympathy and sorrow for the martyrs who sacrificed their lives in the war. Their strength and sacrifice inspires me. The Pakistani forces killed thousands of innocent people, tortured innumerable women, killed many intellectuals of the country. After nine months of fightings we have achieved the golden sun of independence from the barbarous Pakistanis. The sacrifice made by the martyrs will act as a perennial source of inspiration for me to work for the country. The symbolic meaning of the day is that we have won victory over our enemies, the Pakistani rulers. People of Bangladesh proved the fact, through their bloody struggle, that freedom is the birth right of man.
